This is our chance.
Let's prove our justice.
The mafia, huh...?

entries.en: Hell yeah! We just gotta do what we[n]always do!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well yeah, it'd be a pain if they came[n]after you...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But we don't hafta deal with 'em directly![n]We just gotta do what we always do!

entries.speaker: Yusuke

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I'll ask around Kosei and see if[n]there are any victims.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay, I know some girls who go to[n]Shibuya pretty often. I'll check with them[n]about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, and I'm gonna see what[n]I can find on the net.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, let's get back together at the end[n]of the week once we've got all our info!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
